facts.fact: The communications and digital technologies minister gazetted the National Digital and Future Skills Strategy on 23 September 2020, with 28 action points including a nationwide public digital-skills and digital-wellness campaign, a Digital Skills for Decent Jobs for Youth programme and a digital-skills component for the unemployment fund's labour activation programme, then in operation in KwaZulu-Natal; the department is to develop a five-year implementation programme.
